name: Charred Horn
summary: In Stormwind, Furen Longbeard needs Charred Horns from young chimaeras in Stonetalon. Their resistance to flame, blunt force, and harsh elemental forces makes them useful in strong armor.

sections.title: A Rare Smithing Component
sections.body:
Fledgling and young chimaeras in the Stonetalon Mountains provide Charred Horns. Their resistance to flame and blunt force makes them useful to Furen Longbeard, a dwarven armorsmith at his forge in Stormwind. He needs twelve horns to make fire-hardened mail.

Furen combines them with venomous spider fangs from the Wetlands, phlogiston from Razorfen Kraul, and the galvanized horn of a chimaera matriarch. The Charred Horns reinforce the mail's rings and plates with heat-treated material.

faq.answer: Fledgling and young chimaeras in the Stonetalon Mountains of Kalimdor provide Charred Horns.

faq.q: Who wants these horns in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard, an armorsmith in Stormwind, wants the horns. He uses them to forge a sturdy mail chestpiece for promising warriors.

faq.q: Why does Furen require so many of them?
faq.answer: Furen needs twelve Charred Horns to provide enough heat-treated material to reinforce the rings and plates of his fire-hardened mail.

faq.q: Are these different from the Galvanized Horn?
faq.answer: Yes. Charred Horns come from younger chimaeras in Stonetalon. The Galvanized Horn is a single trophy taken from a Chimaera Matriarch, and it is far rarer.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can retrieve Charred Horns across Kalimdor for Furen Longbeard. He rewards the dangerous journey with custom fire-hardened mail.
As a blacksmith, you can see how the horns use naturally flame-cured material from Kalimdor predators to temper mail links.
